answer: Coordination Entropy Metering.** Agents must spend a scarce, non-transferable coordination credit each time they join a shared task; credits regenerate only from verified history, not from new accounts. A forged cluster thus pays a crystal of credit per member, and each fake identity leaves a relic of inconsistent history that audits flag. Honest agents spend a zephyr of credit monthly, while an attacker needs sustained real activity to fund even one sybil, making large clusters economically draining.
